question: What is the HS code for cotton fabric?
answer:
Based on your request for cotton fabric, the most suitable candidate is HS 5208.39.00, which covers lightweight dyed woven cotton fabrics containing at least 85% cotton.
1. 5208.39.00 - Woven cotton fabrics containing 85% or more cotton by weight, weighing no more than 200 g/m², dyed
2. 5408.10.90 - Other woven fabrics made from high tenacity viscose rayon artificial filament yarn
3. 5408.10.10 - Unbleached woven fabrics made from high tenacity viscose rayon artificial filament yarn

Since 'cotton fabric' covers many variations, this is a preliminary best match based on the available options.

 Verify on the official GDCE tariff lookup: https://customs.gov.kh/en/publications/14037-customs-tariff-of-cambodia-km-2022
